channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US, Iran engaged in tanker war: Where is the months-long conflict headed?
item.description: The US and Iran attack tankers in Strait of Hormuz, as the two sides try to exert control over the strategic waterway.

item.title: Israeli air attacks on Lebanon kill at least four
item.description: Two women killed in an air attack on Arab Salim, and two people killed in strike on Nabatieh al-Fawqa.

item.title: Yemeni forces claim strategic district amid intensified Houthi clashes
item.description: More than 60 people, including civilians, killed as clashes between Yemeni forces and Houthis intensify in Taiz.

item.title: More than 20 killed in fire at wedding party in DR Congo
item.description: Authorities have launched an investigation into a fire that killed 22 people at a wedding party in Kinshasa, DR Congo.

item.title: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares
item.description: The US says it hit three Iranian oil tankers, while Iran says it targeted three US-linked ships.

item.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
item.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

item.title: 'We expect our sons to be killed,' father of teen shot dead in West Bank tells BBC
item.description: Palestinian teenagers Omar al-Naasan and Khalil Abu Alia were shot dead when Israeli settlers and soldiers entered a village in the occupied West Bank.
